name: DevelopingPolaroidRow
job: Show photos as instant prints that slowly develop from milky blank to full colour as they scroll in, then straighten when hovered
visitor_action: scroll the scene into view to develop the prints; hover or focus a print to shake it and hurry the develop; click, tap, Enter or Space enlarges it, Escape sets it down
mobile: hero print plus 2 supporting prints, all fully in frame, tap enlarges
motion: prints drop onto a studio sweep, rest milky for a beat, then develop in a staggered chemical wave — blue-green blotches clear, colour overshoots and a flash bloom pops as it lands, the emulsion rim lingers last and captions ink in; the develop replays each time a print scrolls back into view; hovering or focusing a finished print shakes it and develops it again faster (a print still developing is hurried) (reduced-motion: prints lie still, fully developed)

checks.craft: skipped (no self-scoring; Guy reviews in the gallery)

art_direction: Studio flash: cool grey seamless sweep with a soft flash hotspot, glossy white instant prints with real slab edges, a chemical blue-green develop that clears in blotches leaving an emulsion rim, blue-ink handwritten captions
